verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI assistant or model product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Gemini can be self-hosted. Every source describes Google-hosted surfaces: the Gemini Apps (web, mobile, Mac), the hosted Gemini API at generativelanguage.googleapis.com, and AI Studio. The Gemini CLI evidence covers only configuring MCP servers, not running the core product on your own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
